win_cause: Slaughtered the Communion's rescued dead on the Wintervast road
loss_cause: Left the rescued dead holding the Wintervast road

options.success_message: The rescued dead lower their hands when their living names are remembered.
options.failure_message: The name reaches them, but the Preservation still holds. The fight continues.

options.success_message: One of the rescued dead accepts that preservation was not consent and leaves the line.
options.failure_message: The line hears the appeal and closes ranks. The fight continues.

options.success_message: One rescued soldier turns on the keeper who reduced a life to a holding.
options.failure_message: The rescued soldier cannot yet look past Stet's ledger. The fight continues.

spared.cause: Spared the Communion's rescued dead after calling them by their living names
spared.renown_cause: Won safe passage without striking the rescued dead
spared.message: The rescued dead stand aside without another wound.

slain.cause: Slaughtered the Communion's rescued dead on the Wintervast road
slain.renown_cause: Cut down the rescued dead after the parley opened
slain.message: The rescued dead are destroyed by force.

fled.cause: Abandoned the parley and left the rescued dead holding the Wintervast road
fled.renown_cause: Withdrew after asking the rescued dead to remember themselves
fled.message: The company yields the road to the rescued dead.
